name: il-s42-equal-pay-rate-paid
summary: The week after the 720-hour crossing of il-s42-720h-crossing-midweek (crossed on October 14, 2026, on file). The client's figures are in from Monday October 19: a comparable direct hire earns $18.50 an hour, and benefits are paid in lieu at an hourly cash value of $1.25 (820 ILCS 175/42(a)(1)(A), (b)). The worker, on a $17.00 rate card billed at $24.00, works 9 hours a day, Monday to Friday (45 h). From October 19 the pay rate is at least $18.50 + $1.25 = $19.75, so the regular rate is $19.75 and overtime is 1.5 × $19.75 = $29.625: pay 40 h × $19.75 = $790.00 and 5 h × $29.625 = $148.125 → $148.13 (rounded half up once). Billing stays on the rate card: 40 h × $24.00 = $960.00 and 5 h × $36.00 = $180.00. Each pay line says why its rate is above the card's; no warning that the equal-pay rate is missing.

equalPayRules.citation: 820 ILCS 175/42(a) (P.A. 103-1030, eff. 2024-08-09) — equal pay and benefits (or their hourly cash value, § 42(b)) after more than 720 hours at the same third party client within a 12-month period, counting work on or after April 1, 2024; § 42(a)(2)(B), (c): more than 4,160 hours within a 48-month period; 56 Ill. payLines.explain: Regular: 40h 00m (2400 min) × $19.75/h = 79000¢ exactly → $790.00. Rule straight_time: hours up to the 40h 00m weekly threshold in the workweek starting 2026-10-19. Illinois equal pay from 2026-10-19 (820 ILCS 175/42(a), (b)): the comparable direct hire's rate $18.50 + the benefits' hourly cash value $1.25 = $19.75, above the rate card's $17.00.

Overtime: 5h 00m (300 min) × $29.625/h (1.5 × $19.75) = 14812.5¢ → rounded half-up once → $148.13. Rule weekly_overtime: 45h 00m worked in the workweek starting 2026-10-19 is 5h 00m over the 40h 00m threshold (Illinois Minimum Wage Law, 820 ILCS 105/4a(1) — over 40 hours in a workweek at not less than 1.5x the regular rate; Fair Labor Standards Act, 29 U.S.C. § 207(a)(1); 29 C.F.R. Part 778 — over 40 hours in a workweek at not less than 1.5x the regular rate). Illinois equal pay from 2026-10-19 (820 ILCS 175/42(a), (b)): the comparable direct hire's rate $18.50 + the benefits' hourly cash value $1.25 = $19.75, above the rate card's $17.00.

billLines.explain: Billed regular: 40h 00m (2400 min) × $24.00/h = 96000¢ exactly → $960.00. Bill rate from the rate card.
Billed overtime: 5h 00m (300 min) × $36.00/h (1.5 × $24.00 bill rate) = 18000¢ exactly → $180.00. Client bills overtime at the rate-card overtime multiplier; bill rate from the rate card.
